content.text: Módulo 2 — Objetos, descrições e ações cotidianas
plural regular de substantivos e artigos.
os, as, uns, umas, livros, casas, amigos, mesas
Produce at least five accurate sentences and answer at least three questions on the topic “Objects and people in your home” using this lesson’s target structure.
Plural articles agree with plural nouns: os/as/uns/umas, usually with noun + s.
English articles do not mark plural gender; Portuguese articles do.
Choose one option for each meaning; say the chosen sentence aloud.
Complete the missing target form. The English meaning is provided to remove ambiguity; read each whole sentence aloud.

questions.questionText: Which sentence expresses “The books are new.”?
Which sentence expresses “The houses are big.”?
Which sentence expresses “These are two books.”?
Which sentence expresses “Some friends are here.”?
________ livros são novos. (The books are new.)
________ casas são grandes. (The houses are big.)
________ dois livros. (These are two books.)
________ amigos estão aqui. (Some friends are here.)

content.text: Read the text aloud. Then answer the questions in full sentences.

As duas mesas e quatro cadeiras estão na sala. Os livros são novos. As professoras estão na escola. Uns amigos estão aqui. As casas da rua são pequenas. Os alunos são brasileiros e os professores são americanos.
As casas da rua são grandes ou pequenas?
Both article and noun signal plural.
Some tables are in the room.
o livro / os livros: one identified book versus several.
Start from the base sentence. Say the new sentence in Portuguese for the English cue, without writing it first.
→ Some tables are in the room.
Translate into Portuguese and say each sentence aloud.
Some tables are in the room.
Fill the missing form in a two-clause context; say both sentences together. The English hint gives the meaning of the second sentence.

content.text: Read the text and answer the questions in full sentences.

Duas amigas estão em casa. Os livros e as revistas estão na mesa. Uns professores estão no trabalho. As casas perto da escola são bonitas. Os alunos estão na sala. Umas bolsas são brancas e outras são azuis.
Os livros e as revistas estão na mesa ou na sala?
As casas perto da escola são bonitas?
Os professores estão em casa ou no trabalho?
Write 4–6 sentences on the topic “Objects and people in your home”. Use at least three different relevant examples of the target structure; add context and original details.

Record one uninterrupted spoken response to these three lesson prompts — Quantos livros estão na mesa? / As casas são grandes? / Uns amigos estão aqui? — giving complete sentences and without reading a script.
I am American. → Eu sou americano.
Keep final -s audible; regional realizations vary.
1. B (Os livros são novos.); 2. A (As casas são grandes.); 3. B (São dois livros.); 4. A (Uns amigos estão aqui.)
